newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Enterprise seen in HK$1.2 bln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Enterprise seen in HK$1.2 bln IPO - sources.

text.p: Beijing Enterprise Ltd is expected to raise over HK$1.2 billion in its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong later in May, market sources said.

The Beijing municipal government-backed Hong Kong company is expected to issue 150 million shares at a price ranging from HK$8 to HK$9.70 per share, representing a price/earnings multiple of 12.7 to 14.8 times, sources said.
Beijing Enterprise is a mini conglomerate with a diversified business involving in manufacturing, retailing, road operations, telecommunications, and property investment, sources said.
The company is initially expected to run its IPO from May 15 to 23 with dealing in shares to begin on May 30, sources said.
Peregrine and Morgan Stanley are expected to be the sponsors of the issue, they said.
